Every plane contains its vertex, so the 27-line theorem and exact finite F4 enumeration yield all planes; squared normal-gradient quadratics with no common zero establish zero special tangent spaces. The coefficient of t*u*v in every modulo-four lifted cubic is invariant and equals 2B(a,b), which is nonzero on exactly twelve planes. Fifteen matching planes are integral sections. Proper quasi-finite gives finite; each complete local ring is a quotient of unramified Witt DVR by Nakayama, and integral sections/nonlift modulo four imply exponent infinity/one. The claimed ring scheme follows without treating finite tests as universal proofs.
